Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Security
Sponsor: Wood (R)
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 02/09/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 104 as introduced increases the maximum combined total of dealer and motorcycle dealer license plates a used motor vehicle dealer may purchase from the Alabama Department of Revenue from five, currently, to ten. The registration fees for these dealer license plates are $25 each, as established by administrative rule of the Department.
This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Allen Treadaway, Chair
Public Safety and Homeland Security
